rationale: M49 W4 (ledger T2, rotated-sample finding). The svelte-repo .d.ts corpus re-declares interface properties in a derived interface (HTMLAttributes.ontoggle over DOMAttributes.ontoggle, BaseElement.name over BaseNode.name, ...). The analyzer's heritage rule is intentional and emitted all 19 of those edges; the F5 truth oracle registered only method_signature, so they surfaced as unexplained fabrication. This fixture pins the analyzer half (exact count 2 — a second member and a non-redeclared member must NOT pair), while the oracle mirror (`property_signature` in the member set) is verified on the corpus. Mutant: typescript/property-override-drop.
